msg: three shanties: Drunken Sailor, Haul Away Joe and Leave Her, Johnny
at sea a shanty plays with its lyric caption

js: (() => { const seen = new Set(), caps = new Set(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { A.update(6); seen.add(A.songTitle); if (A.text) caps.add(A.songTitle + ': ' + A.text); } window.CAPS = [...caps]; return [...seen]; })()
['Haul Away Joe', 'Leave Her, Johnny'].every(t => CAPS.some(c => c.startsWith(t + ':')))
msg: the new shanties come round in turn, each with captions

js: (() => { const p = G.player; const e = G.spawn({ cls: 'brigantine', nation: 'pirate', role: 'pirate', name: 'Rook', x: p.x + 120, z: p.z, psi: Math.PI, v: 3 }); e.path = null; window.EN = e.id; return e.C.guns; })()

msg: when a ship attacks, the music turns to battle drums (no shanty caption)
